summary: Default-absent actual-client preparation implementation works on its selected tracer and inherited scope; two final frozen-snapshot probes expose remaining contracts. Finite functional repair budget consumed; no further production repair or policy activation.
implementation: Explicit trusted operator-injected frozen QualifiedPreparationRules; absent by default, not model-decoded, no budget parameter.
First complete actual baseline and original oldest receipt time; fixed 120-second envelope; unchanged per-resource <5s default.
Final validated high-water envelope, frame-order transient mutation and future/rollback receipt invalidation, irreversible retirement.
One guarded quantity-one C8, existing C6 five-second deadline, original NPC cap, item/shop expiry, stock/SELF slot/budget/source/receipt guards retained.
Same-map qualified movement/NPC lane only. Warp/reload and unrecognized actions/observations retire; no global mutation ledger or action vocabulary expansion.

quality.scope: Five owned files Black/Ruff; strict no-incremental mypy all src plus six selected tests (114 checked files); whole-source Xenon B/B/A and duplicate-code Pylint. Not root check/audit.

tdd.initial_vertical_red: 4 behavioral failures for missing qualification method; 4 unchanged default-denial controls passed. Genuine actual constructor/framer/ring/observer path.
tdd.vertical_green: Initial opt-in tracer plus original purchase/retirement/capacity scope passed.
tdd.barrier_red: 5 behavioral defects plus 4 erroneous status_params[24] assertions; corrected to real capacity collector after preserving receipt.
tdd.repair_red: 15 failures/48 passes: includes one wrong missing-weight oracle (inherited actual constructor already received weight10). Kept original frames/times; corrected oracle without redating. Remaining faults repaired within the one functional/quality repair.
tdd.repair_green: 63 owned and 89 purchase/retirement/capacity cases passed; subsequent quality refactor only.
tdd.final_remaining: Two later frozen-source contract probes remain RED; these are not claimed tests-first completed implementation.

blocking_remaining_contracts.finding: Actual prequalification opening of NPC123 is accepted by rules that qualify only merchant456. Record/bind the prequalification opening target and map (or require qualification before any opening); deny unqualified prior interactions. Do not infer no-effect from global map labels.
blocking_remaining_contracts.owned_repair_boundary: native_resource_preparation.py request/qualify; playing_runtime.py qualification seam if needed

blocking_remaining_contracts.finding: Opted-in build_native_state with 10**1000 reaches inherited NPC math.isfinite and raises OverflowError before preparation retirement. Purchase and action admission clock tests pass, but all active-lane readers require a qualified finite sample before received processing. Preserve default NPC/capacity-only semantics.

conditional_assumptions: Trusted selected-world/route/NPC qualifications must exclude suppressed deletion, asynchronous or otherwise unobservable resource effects. Continuous TCP is not evidence of those exclusions.
Last-received precheck is not atomic server state, socket backlog absence, legality or no-loss/refund guarantee.
Loaded weight321 and slot allowance10 are synthetic test facts only; real UNKNOWN loaded weight still denies.
Only wrapper-owned controlled requests are within this lane; no raw/foreign native action or malicious operator bypass is authorized.
